description: PERMANENTLY delete one Vercel deployment: its URL stops working and Vercel has no undo. Without confirm:true nothing is deleted and you get the deployment it would delete (URL, target, state) to show the user; a production deployment the domains still serve takes the site down. Call again with confirm:true only after the user says yes to that exact deployment. Free. Needs Vercel connected (Settings > Connectors > Vercel, or connect_connector with an access token).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved deleting this exact deployment
